# Forum — Tasks

## Template Info

- **Name**: Forum
- **Source**: ColorLib Conference (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/conference/)
- **Preview**: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/conference/

## Design Tokens

- Brand: #8ab92d (lime green)
- Dark navy: #04091e
- Dark gray: #222
- Light bg: #f9f9ff
- Body text: #777
- Headings: #222
- Font: Poppins (300-700)
- Button radius: 50px (pill)

## Sections (in order)

1. Navbar — fixed, dark scroll effect, green CTA
2. Hero — full-screen overlay, countdown, date/location
3. VideoAbout — split: text + video overlay
4. DarkAbout — dark bg, image + text
5. VideoSection — text + video carousel
6. Speakers — dark bg, speaker cards
7. Schedule — table with sessions
8. Pricing — 4 tier cards with hover
9. BrandLogos — grayscale → color on hover
10. CTA — full-width overlay section
11. Footer — dark, 3 columns, Component Dock link

## Replication Notes

- Original uses Bootstrap grid → Tailwind flexbox/grid
- Original uses Owl Carousel → static cards (simpler)
- Original uses jQuery plugins → React state/effects
- Images: picsum.photos seeded placeholders
- Brand icons: inline SVG (lucide-react removed brand icons)
- All original text content preserved section-for-section
